name: Prime Degree Frontier
curve_scope: every registered standard prime-field curve (nonempty standard_names); one leaderboard per exact ICV1 model
representation: full normalized rational map and monic kernel polynomial
score: largest independently verified odd prime degree, represented as a decimal integer
ties: equal degrees share rank; no timing tiebreak
construction: any algorithm; constructor costs are reported separately and are not independently attested for external entries
excluded: custom curves substituted for a registered model
record_scope: this challenge and its pinned catalogue; no worldwide-record or mathematical-maximum claim
